title: Adopted secure development standard and SSDF/SAMM self-assessment
description: The formally adopted secure development standard with approval record, and a dated self-assessment mapping practices to NIST SSDF tasks and OWASP SAMM maturity levels, with gaps and owners.
format: Markdown policy with front matter plus assessment table

title: Security requirement traceability report
description: Generated traceability from security requirements and invariants to code changes, tests and evidence, with gaps (requirements with no test, changes with no mapped control) listed.
producer: Praxis validation (exists for record integrity; security traceability not configured)

title: Code review and approval records per change
description: For each merged change: author identity (human or agent), reviewers and their independence from the author, whether the change touched control-relevant modules, automated check results and approval timestamps.
producer: Source control platform plus Praxis provenance events (proposed integration)
format: Pull request metadata export plus provenance events

title: Security testing results per build
description: Results of static analysis, dependency analysis, secret scanning, property and negative tests and dynamic tests per build, with tool versions, rule sets, suppressions and gate outcome.
format: SARIF plus test reports plus gate summary

title: Developer and agent security competence records
description: Records of role-based secure development training completion for human developers, and version-controlled security instructions, guardrails and evaluation results for AI coding agents.
format: Training records plus agent instruction file versions

title: AI coding agent provenance and permission records
description: Per-change records identifying the agent, model, runtime, session, tools and permissions used, files changed and the human accountable for acceptance; plus the agent permission configuration in force.
producer: Praxis work protocol and provenance (exists in tool repositories; not operated for a product)
format: Praxis events (JSON Lines) plus agent configuration snapshot
notes: Praxis records agent actor identity and content digests for repository work (praxis@12bf9951 docs/work-protocol.md, docs/agent-provenance.md). Actor identity is self-reported by the executing process and is not independently authenticated.

title: Language, unsafe code and native interop inventory
description: Per-build inventory of languages and runtimes in the shipped product, compiler settings (warnings as errors, unsafe code disallowed), every native interop or unsafe block, and every non-F# component with its approval.

title: Secure software development attestation package
description: Signed attestation of conformance to secure development practices (for example the CISA common form) with supporting SSDF evidence, plan of action for gaps and the officer who signed.

title: Development environment and test data controls evidence
description: Configuration evidence that development, test and production are separated, that production data is not used in non-production without approved masking, and that secrets are absent from source and injected at runtime.
format: Configuration snapshots plus secret scan results
